title: PORT-BRANCH-parked-agent-sys-reconcile: carry parked/agent/SYS-RECONCILE onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `parked/agent/SYS-RECONCILE` at 3660b1ee89 holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: doctrine/code-agents.json, doctrine/system.json, doctrine/topology.json, foundation/__main__.py, foundation/agent_ladder.py, instances/ultrastable/system/ultrastable-agents.wrangler.jsonc)
**Done check:** probe:git rev-list --count origin/main..origin/parked/agent/SYS-RECONCILE is 0, or the branch's content is carried by a merged change
**Status:** open

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 1 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --scan --json shows no `port` for parked/agent/SYS-RECONCILE
